author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:1990397 queuosine salvage
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29892.
Consider transfer annotations to new terms GO:0160255 tRNA queuosine(34) biosynthetic process from salvaged queuine or GO:0160254 tRNA queuosine(34) biosynthetic process from salvaged queuosine).

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 

EcoCyc	UniProtKB:P37619	yhhQ	PMID:28208705		GO:1990397	queuosine salvage	IDA			PANTHER:PTHR34300	20170307		NCBITaxon:83333

Impacted groups: 
EcoCyc

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
GO:1990397	unirule2go	UniRule:UR000497466 > GO:queuosine salvage ; GO:1990397
GO:1990397	hamap2go	HAMAP:MF_02088 > GO:queuosine salvage ; GO:1990397
GO:1990397	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR003744 Queuosine precursor transporter > GO:queuosine salvage ; GO:1990397



Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:1990397 queuosine salvage

author: amandamackie
body:
I've removed the single annotation to GO:1990397 queuosine salvage in EcoCyc.

E. coli imports the queuosine precursors preQ0 (7-cyano-7-deazaguanine) and preQ1 (7-ammoniomethyl-7-deazaguanine). 

Can the definition of GO:0160254 be modified to include these compounds. eg. GO:0160254 tRNA queuosine(34) biosynthetic process from salvaged queuosine **or its precursors**).

author: raymond91125
body: It is in the definition but I'll add it to the label as well. Thanks.
